ios.desc:
You have a collection of records, and you are proud that your mixer does not have a sync button. Enter, Scan, or Import your records, adjust the BPM per song. Then, at the party, tap the tempo of what is sounding, and the app will tell you what songs are close to it.
Or put the videos of the songs on a playlist and listen to your records on the go!
Features:
-	In the Rack:
  o	Add records to your collection by scanning the bar code, scanning the center label, searching online, typing them manually, or importing the data in bulk from a Comma Delimited File
  o	Search on your collection by different fields or browse by artist.
  o	Add / remove songs per record.
  o	Edit record information, with name, side, track, and BPM.
  o	Add, Edit, or remove videos associated with the record!
  o	Type the video to watch it or slide to the right to add it to the play list!
-	In the BPMs:
  o	Select a song to enter the BPMs by tapping! Or use the listening feature
-	In the Mix:
  o	Search songs by Beats Per Minute, or by tapping at the tempo of what you are hearing!
  o	Search result will be for the other songs in different records in your collection that have a close BPM.
-	In the Playlist:
  o	Just play the songs queued so you can take your collection of music on the go!
